meta.purpose: Blind numeric battery. Keys were generated independently by gen_key.py from first-principles computations; answers-attempt2.json was written from the problem statements alone. Agreement = two independent derivations match; any mismatch is a real error to revisit.

questions.prompt: Edges S-A(2), S-B(1), A-C(2), B-C(4), C-G(2). Heuristic h(S)=4,h(A)=2,h(B)=3,h(C)=1,h(G)=0 is admissible (check it). What is the optimal path cost S->G?
Root is MAX with two MIN children: B has leaves 8 and 4; C has leaves 3 and 7. Minimax value at the root?
KB: (~P(x) v Q(x)); (~Q(y) v R(y)); P(a). Negate the goal R(a) and resolve to the empty clause. How many resolution steps (including the final one against ~R(a))?
Chain X->Y->Z, all binary. P(X=1)=0.3; P(Y=1|X=1)=0.8; P(Y=1|X=0)=0.2; P(Z=1|Y=1)=0.7; P(Z=1|Y=0)=0.1. P(Z=1) to three decimals?
Perceptron rule w <- w + t*x, rate 1, sign(0) counts as error, start w=(0,0), one full epoch over A(1,2)+ B(1,-1)- C(1,0.5)-. Give w as 'w1,w2' after the epoch.
